name: Split web pages into vector-ready chunks with Ragfeed

parameters.content:
## Split web pages into vector-ready chunks with Ragfeed

### Who it's for
Anyone building a RAG chatbot or knowledge base in n8n who wants web pages as clean, ready-to-embed records instead of raw HTML.

### How it works
1. **Set page and chunk size** holds the URL and the maximum chunk size.
2. **Fetch page as chunks** calls the Ragfeed API (`POST /v2/scrape`, format `chunks`). Ragfeed renders the page, drops navigation, footers and cookie notices, and splits the main content along its headings.
3. **One item per chunk** turns the list into one n8n item per chunk.

Each chunk has a stable `id` (UUID from the normalized URL and position, so re-fetching the same page overwrites instead of duplicating), `text`, `embedText`, `tokens`, the heading path and flat `metadata` (URL, title, language, fetch time, `hash`).

### Requirements
A Ragfeed API key (starts with `sk-`). The free plan has 1,000 credits a month; one page costs 1 credit, chunks cost nothing extra. Sign-up and dashboard are in German: https://ragfeed.de/en

### How to customize
Connect **One item per chunk** to your embeddings and vector store nodes (Qdrant, Pinecone, Supabase, Postgres/pgvector). Use `id` as the point id and `embedText` as the text to embed. Change `maxTokens` (100 to 4,000) for smaller or larger chunks.

## Setup
1. Create a credential **Header Auth**:
   - **Name:** `Authorization`
   - **Value:** `Bearer sk-...` (your Ragfeed API key)
2. Select it in **Fetch page as chunks**.
3. Put your page into **Set page and chunk size** and run the workflow.

The key lives in the credential, never in the node.

### Fetch and split
Ragfeed returns `data.chunks`; **One item per chunk** splits the list. Connect your embedding model and vector store after it.
